UnitStatement: OpenPipeStress agentic development uses a flat hierarchy with no phases, sub-packages, or task sub-levels inside deliverables.
The decomposition hierarchy is execution/_Decomposition/SOFTWARE_DECOMP.md -> PKG-XX Package -> DEL-XX-YY Deliverable.
Package identity is a domain partition, not a schedule phase; delivery sequencing may be managed separately.
A Scope Item uses ID format SOW-NNN (e.g., SOW-003) and is assigned by SOFTWARE_DECOMP.
An Objective uses ID format OBJ-NNN (e.g., OBJ-001) and is assigned by SOFTWARE_DECOMP.
A Package uses ID format PKG-XX (e.g., PKG-04) and is assigned by SOFTWARE_DECOMP.
A Deliverable uses ID format DEL-XX-YY (e.g., DEL-04-02) and is assigned by SOFTWARE_DECOMP.
A Decision uses ID format DEC-NNN (e.g., DEC-001) and is assigned by human or Type 1 agent draft.
An Open Issue uses ID format OI-NNN (e.g., OI-004) and is assigned by Type 1 agent draft or human.
A Risk uses ID format RISK-NNN (e.g., RISK-002) and is assigned by Type 1 agent draft or human.
Deliverable IDs are coupled to package IDs (DEL-04-02 belongs to PKG-04) and IDs persist across renames.
DOC_UPDATE is a software deliverable type for documentation, policy, guide, or report-template work.
DATA_MODEL_CHANGE is a software deliverable type for schema, type, serialization, or domain object change.
API_CONTRACT is a software deliverable type for public API, plugin, import/export, or data contract.
BACKEND_FEATURE_SLICE is a software deliverable type for bounded backend/core behavior implementation.
UX_UI_SLICE is a software deliverable type for a bounded GUI feature or view.
TEST_SUITE is a software deliverable type for verification, regression, validation, or lint suite.
CI_CD_CHANGE is a software deliverable type for build, packaging, release, or pipeline change.
SECURITY_CONTROL is a software deliverable type for privacy, redaction, storage, telemetry, or security control.
MODEL_INCOMPLETE status means required physical data for solving is missing; authority level is software finding.
MECHANICS_SOLVED status means numerical mechanics solve completed; authority level is solver result only.
RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE status means mechanics may be solved but rule-pack required values are missing; authority level is rule-pack finding.
USER_RULE_CHECKED status means a user-defined rule pack evaluated the result; authority is software computation using user data.
USER_RULE_FAILED status means a user-defined rule pack produced a failing result; authority is software computation using user data.
HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED status means the result requires competent engineering review before reliance; always true for professional use.
HUMAN_APPROVED_FOR_PROJECT status means a human recorded project-specific acceptance outside the solver core; it is a human record only.
Automatic software-emitted statuses are limited to MODEL_INCOMPLETE, MECHANICS_SOLVED, RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE, USER_RULE_CHECKED, USER_RULE_FAILED, and HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED.
The software must not use HUMAN_APPROVED_FOR_PROJECT, CODE_COMPLIANT, CERTIFIED, SEALED, APPROVED, or equivalent professional/code-compliance language as an automatic status.
The code-neutral analysis boundary is the data-model surface that keeps analysis statuses from collapsing into one another.

schemas/analysis_boundary.schema.yaml requires an explicit authority model: mechanics statuses from solver results, user-rule statuses from user rule-pack computation, human acceptance as an external hash-bound project record only.
Epistemic label FACT means directly observed in a cited source or model artifact.
Epistemic label ASSUMPTION means a reasonable inference requiring human validation.
Epistemic label PROPOSAL means a suggested design/development move requiring decision.
Epistemic label TBD means unknown or unwarranted and must be resolved before reliance.
Open Mechanics is public analytical mechanics implemented by the solver (geometry, stiffness, loads, stress recovery, units, reports) and may be shipped publicly.

Protected Standards Data includes code text, tables, figures, code-derived formulas, allowables, SIF/flexibility tables, and protected dimensional tables, and must not be shipped publicly without explicit redistribution rights.
User-Supplied Code Data is values, formulas, allowables, SIFs, flexibility factors, load combinations, and interpretations entered by the user; may be stored in private project/rule-pack files.
Mechanics Solve is a solved numerical model with displacements, reactions, forces, moments, and mechanical stresses; not equivalent to a code check.
Rule-Pack Check is a user-defined expression/comparison applied to solver outputs; not equivalent to professional authentication.
Professional Approval is human acceptance for reliance by a competent/responsible professional and is outside software authority.
Centerline Model is a 3D line-element representation of the piping centerline and components; the default global analysis model.

Frame Kernel is the code-neutral 3D frame mechanics core owning DOF ordering, element stiffness, transforms, assembly, boundary-condition reduction, and a bounded solve interface; it does not perform rule checks or professional approval.

Solver Diagnostic is a deterministic mechanics-solver finding for singularity, invalid topology/restraints, numeric invalidity, conditioning, nonconvergence, or unresolved solver configuration; not a rule-pack result or compliance statement.
Local FEA Handoff is a transfer package for local shell/solid analysis; a specialized workflow, not the default global solver.

Plugin Manifest is a declared extension metadata record requesting entrypoints, permissions, provenance, privacy posture, checksums, sandbox requirements, and no-bypass constraints; a manifest grants nothing by itself.

Extension Point is a governed boundary where a plugin or adapter may request to import, export, validate, report, emit diagnostics, or expose user-owned rule-pack metadata; exact loader and transport remain TBD.

Domain Surface is the model, persistence, unit, analysis-boundary, rule-pack metadata, result, report, or diagnostic surface touched by an extension entrypoint and must be declared in the plugin manifest.

No-Bypass Constraint is a mandatory control plugins and adapters must preserve (units, provenance, privacy, protected-content, diagnostics, hashes, rule sandboxing, reports, solver boundaries, human acceptance boundaries) and cannot be waived by plugin code.
Provenance label USER_SUPPLIED_LICENSED_CODE means the user entered a value from a licensed code/standard.
Provenance label USER_SUPPLIED_OWNER_SPEC means the user entered a value from owner/company design basis.
Provenance label MANUFACTURER_PUBLIC_PERMISSIVE means manufacturer data with documented redistribution rights.
Provenance label MANUFACTURER_PRIVATE means manufacturer/vendor data for private project use only.
Provenance label PUBLIC_DOMAIN_OR_ORIGINAL means public-domain/original/invented data safe for public examples.
Provenance label UNKNOWN_SOURCE means the source is not documented and cannot be relied on without review.
Provenance label PROTECTED_CONTENT_SUSPECTED means quarantine and escalate before public use.
The canonical machine-readable domain model is schemas/model.schema.yaml, using JSON Schema 2020-12 written as strict JSON in a .yaml path, and is intentionally code-neutral.

schemas/model.schema.yaml defines public object structure, identifiers, references, unit-bearing values, provenance, diagnostics, results, and report settings, but bundles no protected standards data, proprietary catalog values, code allowables, SIF/flexibility tables, or compliance rules.
PKG-02 owns the canonical semantic dimension vocabulary used by both schemas/units.schema.yaml DimensionId and schemas/model.schema.yaml Quantity.dimension.

Canonical dimension vocabulary includes dimensionless, length, mass, time, temperature, temperature_interval, angle, rotation, force, force_per_length, moment, pressure, stress, area, volume, density, and TBD among others.

Retired aliases are not accepted canonical enum values: use temperature_interval not temperature_difference, second_moment_area not area_moment, and linear_stiffness or rotational_stiffness for generic stiffness.
Unit catalogs, conversion constants, tolerances, code-specific values, release claims, and professional claims remain out of scope for the dimension vocabulary.

Project is the registry container for units, privacy/storage posture, models, rule-pack references, report settings, reports, diagnostics, and hashes; project-private data remains user controlled unless intentionally contributed with documented rights.

Model is a physical or derived analytical model container for nodes, elements, components, materials, sections, supports, load cases, combinations, results, diagnostics, assumptions, traceability links, and references; physical_source_of_truth anchors editable design data.

ModelRole is a schema enum distinguishing a physical source-of-truth model from an analytical solver model, derived view, or unresolved TBD role; it is not a lifecycle or professional-approval status.

DesignKnowledgeEnvelope holds schema-first records for user-supplied endpoints, line data, routing corridors, zones, equipment interfaces, requirements, owner/project metadata, source notes, assumptions, diagnostics, and provenance; public examples must be invented or cleared.

ModelStateRecord is a named immutable model snapshot with tags, notes, external references, assumptions, warnings, analysis-status references, deterministic hashes, provenance, and read-only semantics; not a prover approval or compliance state.
Node is an addressable point with unit-aware coordinates and six-degree-of-freedom state fields; missing imposed values or constraints are findings, not silent defaults.

Element is an analytical member connecting node references with material, section, optional component, governed local-coordinate, and result-station hooks; straight-pipe local coordinates require a y_reference orientation basis and local_x_axis is not canonical.

FrameKernel is a Rust mechanics module for two-node 3D frame stiffness, local/global transforms, dense assembly, boundary-condition reduction, and temporary dense solve verification; sparse solver and conversion constants remain TBD.
StraightPipeElement is a Rust mechanics module that adapts explicit straight-pipe section and mass properties into the frame-kernel element boundary and recovers local mechanical element forces.

LinearSupport is a Rust mechanics-boundary module for anchors, guides, line stops, vertical supports, linear springs, and imposed displacement data mapped to frame-kernel DOFs; nonlinear behavior is out of scope.

NonlinearSupportActiveSet is a Rust mechanics module that classifies one-way, gap/lift-off/contact, and friction-limited support states during nonlinear iterations and records active-set changes and nonconvergence diagnostics.
SolverDiagnostics is a Rust mechanics-diagnostics module that maps frame-kernel errors and solver state facts to deterministic diagnostic codes, severities, sources, and statuses.

SolverPerformanceHarness is a Rust observer/regression module that runs invented or public-permissive frame fixtures repeatedly and records matrix metrics, residuals, repeatability deltas, conditioning observations, provenance, assumptions, and limitations.

PrimitiveLoadCase is a Rust mechanics module for weight, pressure, thermal, imposed-displacement, hydrotest, wind, seismic, and occasional primitive load categories, preparing explicit solver-boundary contributions.

LoadCaseAlgebra is a Rust mechanics-boundary module for user-defined linear combinations, result-state subtraction, and range envelopes over compatible load/result quantities, preserving unit/dimension intent and analysis statuses.

UserLoadApplication is a Rust mechanics-boundary module for concentrated forces, concentrated moments, and uniform distributed user loads, preparing explicit solver-boundary contributions and result-recovery hooks.

StressRecovery is a Rust mechanics module that recovers axial, bending, torsional, and pressure membrane stress components from explicit resultants and section/pressure inputs; it provides no design-code equations, allowables, or SIF/flexibility factors.

RulePack is a user-owned schema-governed artifact defining required inputs, declarative formula slots, user-supplied value slots, user-rule check definitions, provenance, redistribution status, diagnostics, checksums, and professional-boundary flags.

ExpressionEvaluator is a Rust rule-pack module that evaluates explicit declarative expression trees with variable bindings, dimension metadata, comparisons, and deterministic findings; it does not parse arbitrary text or execute host-language code.

RulePackLifecycle is a Rust rule-pack module that records lifecycle metadata, privacy/redistribution status, protected-content review state, checksum records, and audit-manifest references and hashes caller-supplied canonical payload bytes.

RulePackCompletenessCheck is a Rust rule-pack module that compares required-input declarations with supplied input evidence and emits deterministic rule-check-blocking findings and RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE readiness.

MechanicsBenchmark is a Rust validation fixture and hand-calculation record for open mechanics behavior such as cantilever response, frame assembly, thermal growth, imposed displacement, and stiffness transforms; fixtures must be original/public/permissive.

StressRecoveryBenchmark is a Rust validation fixture and hand-calculation record for code-neutral stress recovery behavior; stress range is not a fatigue check, allowable comparison, code compliance decision, or professional approval.

Component is a piping-specific object such as bend, elbow, branch, reducer, valve, flange, expansion joint, rigid, specialty, or other user-defined component; user modifiers and code/manufacturer values require provenance and may be private.

Material is a user/private or permissively sourced material record with unit-bearing properties, allowable slots, completeness findings, and provenance; the public schema provides no protected allowables or proprietary catalog values.
Section is a pipe/section record with unit-bearing properties and provenance; protected dimensional tables and proprietary catalog data are not public defaults.

SectionLibrary holds governed section records with user-entered dimensions, derived-property slots, completeness findings, provenance, and review status; public fixtures remain schema-shape-only or invented unless source review is complete.

SectionPropertyCalculation is a derived pipe section and mass-property result calculated from user-entered OD, wall, corrosion, density, contents, and insulation inputs; it supplies no dimensional tables or conversion constants.

ComponentLibrary holds governed component records for bends, branches, reducers, valves, flanges, expansion joints, rigid parts, specialty items, and user-defined components; SIFs, flexibility factors, and manufacturer values require provenance and may be private.

LibraryImportProvenanceCheck is an import-boundary validation result for material, section, and component library payloads, recording accept/reject/review/quarantine outcomes without legal conclusions or publishing private/protected values.

BendElbowComponent is a bend or elbow component record with user-entered centerline geometry, orientation metadata, source references, and user-supplied SIF/flexibility slots; protected modifier tables are not public defaults.

BranchConnectionComponent is a branch connection record with user-entered run/header geometry, connection angle/type slots, reinforcement references, and user-supplied SIF/flexibility slots; protected branch tables are not public defaults.

RigidComponent is a valve, flange, reducer, rigid, or specialty component record with user-entered dimensions, connection references, weight, center-of-gravity, stiffness behavior, and source references; protected rating tables are not public defaults.

ExpansionJointComponent is an expansion joint record with user/manufacturer-supplied stiffness, effective-area, movement-limit, hardware, and manufacturer-reference slots; manufacturer and proprietary catalog values are not public defaults.
Support is a restraint/support record with target reference, directions, unit-bearing properties, and active-state result hook; nonlinear solution behavior and convergence semantics are solver-owned.

ViewportEditorSession is a schema-first viewport/editor contract for transient camera, hover, selection, drag, snap, view primitives, diagnostics, and command intents over centerline objects; viewport edits are command intents, not direct persisted mutations.

ViewportCommandIntent is a GUI-generated intent for creating nodes, connecting pipe runs, inserting bend/branch/component symbols, and changing selection through an application-service boundary; intents are unit-aware validation requests and undo/redo candidates.

LoadCase is a primitive loading record with strict typed load-record entries limited to nodal_force, nodal_moment, element_point_force, and element_uniform_distributed_force; code-specific load requirements are user/rule-pack supplied.
Combination is an algebraic grouping of load-case factors with an explicit basis; no public code-specific combination defaults are implied.

RulePackRef is a reference to a user/public rule-pack by identity, version, checksum, source notice, redistribution status, and required-input links; rule formulas and evaluator implementation are outside the schema.
Quantity is a unit-bearing value record with magnitude, unit, dimension, and provenance; dimensionless values must be explicit and missing or incompatible units are findings, not hidden defaults.

Provenance is a source, license, contributor, redistribution, and review-status record used by reliance-affecting data; unknown or suspected protected sources must remain reviewable and cannot be treated as accepted public data.

Reference is a typed stable-object reference used instead of positional coupling where editing, solving, reporting, or audit depends on identity; external references remain explicit and do not bypass schema validation.

Assumption is an explicit unresolved or resolved model assumption with affected references and provenance; assumptions are review evidence and cannot silently become defaults or professional acceptance.

TraceabilityLink is a directed source/target trace record for physical-to-analytical transformation, operation application, state snapshots, analysis runs, comparisons, handoff records, or external references; it does not prove external validation or compliance.

Diagnostic is a result-envelope warning/finding record with code, class, severity, source, affected object, message, remediation, and provenance; diagnostics expose missing data and boundary risks without becoming compliance claims.

Checksum is a hash metadata record with algorithm, canonicalization, payload reference, and value; JSON payload hashes use the JCS-compatible basis and SCA-003 SQLite storage is not the authoritative hash basis.

ProjectPersistenceEnvelope is a versioned create/open/save envelope with schema version, project payload, migration status, hash metadata, diagnostics, round-trip manifest, validation profile, and service-operation contract records; canonical JSON/JCS bytes remain the truth.

PersistenceOperation is an application-service contract record for create, open, save, validate, version-check, and migrate operations that must not bypass schema, unit, provenance, rule-pack reference, private-data, protected-content, or professional-boundary checks.

RoundTripManifest is a persistence comparison record naming semantic equality categories, serialization basis, volatile fields, and normalization rules; round trips preserve engineering-relevant data and insert no silent defaults.

HumanAcceptanceRef is an external human-review or project-acceptance reference bound to specific hashes; it invalidates on bound-hash changes and is not an automatic software approval, certification, sealing, or code-compliance status.
Result is a mechanical, diagnostic, stress, reaction, or user-rule-check result envelope with analysis statuses and unit-aware values; result statuses do not mean automatic code compliance.

AuditManifest is a reproducibility record for model/input hashes, solver version stamp, unit-system reference, rule-pack checksum refs, asset hashes, and privacy/redaction metadata; it records evidence without storing private payloads or making compliance claims.

ReportSettings is report configuration for manifests, provenance summaries, notices, result references, and rule-pack references; report rendering and professional acceptance records remain separate workflows.

Report is an auditable report-facing record for manifests, hashes, statuses, diagnostics, rule-pack refs, provenance summary, and professional-boundary notice; reports are decision support and must not claim certification, sealing, or professional approval.

CalculationReportEnvelope is a schema-first calculation-report assembly contract for model input summary, load cases, result exports, audit manifests, report sections, rule-pack refs, diagnostics, template slots, limitations, and professional-boundary notices.

ReportProtectedContentLintRun is a schema-first linter configuration, target, finding, summary, and provenance contract for public report templates and fixtures; it is deterministic heuristic review evidence and provides no legal or professional clearance.

ReportSectionEnvelope holds schema-first records for report-facing warnings, analysis-status disclosures, assumptions, limitations, user-supplied values, provenance notes, unresolved TBDs, and human-review-needed findings.

ResultExportEnvelope is a schema-first JSON result export contract for review, regression comparison, reports, headless automation, and governed downstream tooling, preserving units, diagnostics, provenance, hashes, and status boundaries.

HeadlessRunnerEnvelope is a schema-first request/result contract for non-GUI solve execution, benchmark automation, regression execution, audit-manifest capture, and result-export handoff; runner outputs preserve units, diagnostics, provenance, and local-first privacy.

AdapterFrameworkEnvelope is a schema-first format-neutral contract for import/export adapter declarations, validation plans, diagnostics, provenance, privacy, checksum/audit refs, result-envelope compatibility, and no-bypass controls; adapters cannot bypass controls or use direct SQL.

Companion schema schemas/section.schema.yaml defines section-library metadata, pipe/section dimension slots, derived-property slots, completeness findings, provenance, and review status; protected dimensional tables are not public defaults.

Companion schema schemas/component.schema.yaml defines component-library metadata, user-entered dimension/weight/COG/stiffness/modifier slots, completeness findings, provenance, and review status; protected SIF/flexibility tables are user-supplied or reviewed.

Companion schema schemas/design_knowledge.schema.json defines schema-first design knowledge records for endpoints, line data, corridors, zones, equipment interfaces, requirements, owner/project metadata, notes, assumptions, diagnostics, and provenance.

Companion schema schemas/model_state.schema.json defines schema-first immutable model state records with state metadata, external references, assumptions, warnings, hashes, provenance, and read-only snapshot semantics; human acceptance remains external and hash-bound.

Companion schema schemas/analysis_boundary.schema.yaml separates mechanics solve authority, user-rule-check authority, missing-input findings, diagnostics, and external human acceptance references; human acceptance is reference-only and hash-bound.
Companion schema schemas/analysis_status.schema.yaml defines result-envelope status semantics and external human acceptance records; HUMAN_APPROVED_FOR_PROJECT is not an automatic software status.

Companion schema schemas/project_persistence.schema.yaml defines the versioned project persistence envelope, round-trip manifest, migration status, hash metadata, validation profile, service operations, private-data markers, and human acceptance references.

Companion schema schemas/rule_pack.schema.yaml defines rule-pack metadata, public/private classification, required inputs, declarative formula slots, user-supplied value slots, check definitions, diagnostics, provenance, redistribution status, checksums, and professional-boundary controls.

Companion schema schemas/report_generator.schema.yaml defines schema-first calculation-report envelopes, template slots, rendered-section metadata, source envelope references, audit/hash refs, rule-pack refs, diagnostics, provenance, privacy classification, and unresolved TBDs.

Companion schema schemas/report_protected_content_linter.schema.yaml defines schema-first protected-content linter configuration, public-surface targets, findings, source locations, review routes, dispositions, summaries, and provenance; DAG-001-E0621 remains non-gating.

Companion schema schemas/report_sections.schema.yaml defines schema-first report-section records for diagnostics, analysis-status disclosures, provenance notes, user-supplied values, assumptions, limitations, unresolved TBDs, and professional-boundary controls.

Companion schema schemas/results.schema.yaml defines schema-first JSON result export envelopes for result identity, model/run references, unit-aware values, diagnostics, provenance, reproducibility refs, analysis status, rule-pack refs, and downstream-use declarations.

Companion schema schemas/viewport_editor.schema.yaml defines schema-first viewport/editor status, camera/transient state, view primitives, selection, diagnostics, provenance, professional-boundary controls, and command intents for centerline editing.

Companion schema schemas/headless_runner.schema.yaml defines the schema-first headless runner request/result envelope for operation identity, project/model/unit/load/input-manifest references, requested outputs, job progress/cancellation, diagnostics, and result/audit refs.

Companion schema schemas/adapter_framework.schema.yaml defines schema-first format-neutral adapter framework envelopes for adapter capability declarations, validation plans, operation results, diagnostics, provenance, privacy, checksum/audit refs, and no-bypass controls.
Lifecycle states for development deliverables progress OPEN -> INITIALIZED -> IN_PROGRESS -> CHECKING -> ISSUED.
ISSUED means accepted as a development artifact by the human project authority; it does not mean professional engineering authentication of any piping calculation.
